Episode 231: Resolution (3)
The Empire, the second city of the former capital, Hairan.
The Grand Rift was not only open in Drakka, but also in all the major bases of the giant forces. Currently, Luna and Luntia were filling Dante's vacancy here.
"Fortunately, we were able to finish before civilian casualties escalated, sister."
Luntia looked up at the sky and spoke.
Just a few minutes ago, the sky was full of rifts from the demon world. The two of them had completely destroyed all rifts before the demons were seriously summoned.

Wherever the rifts had been, there were remnants of the red sword energy and the giant mark of the Brotherhood. Especially, the red sword energy was still intensely flaring up, devouring the spread demon energy and the bodies of the demons.
"Sister, are you sure you didn't overdo it? You used to get tired when you used a lot of red sword energy due to the number limit."
Luntia looked at Luna's expression and spoke. In fact, there was no sign of fatigue, but somehow it was a deep mood.
"No, I'm not tired."
"Then?"
"...I feel suffocated."
Luna's eyes narrowed. She was engulfed by an ominous feeling throughout the battle.
"Are you worried about the youngest?"
"Yes... This time, it seems like an opponent that the youngest can't overcome."
In fact, Luna faintly felt the power of Phaelito. Like Elona read his power.
The power was endlessly dark and huge. Just like the kings of the Black Sea they encountered during the expedition.
"If you say that, you must have felt something. I got it, leave it to me here, and you go to the Holy Kingdom."
Luntia pointed to the grand rifts beginning to open in the distant sky. However, Luna shook her head.
"No, I'll keep looking after this place. You go and support."
A firm voice.
Of course, Luna was more worried about Jin than anyone else. She wanted to rush to help her youngest sibling right now.
But, the Small Great Master ordered to protect the empire.
So, even if one of the two goes to support, it is right for the person who can better carry out that command alone to stay in the empire, and that was definitely Luna.
Luntia did not argue. There was no way the Knights wouldn't know the law of Runcandel.
"Okay. Then I'll immediately return to the main force and connect with the Small Great Master. I'll also select one person to replace my position and send them here."
Luna lifted Krantel high. The red sword energy that dyed the sky began to swirl and gather into Krantel's blade.
"Sure, Luntia, I'm counting on you. As soon as things settle down here, I'll join you."
Holy King City.
A golden barrier enveloped the Holy King City. It was a protective shield formed by Lani and the clerics, using the energy of Ayula that Phaelito had destroyed.
"Haah, ha...!"
Queen Lani was on her knees in front of the iron gate to the Eternal Warehouse, in the lowest basement of the Holy King City, pulling up divine power.

The yellow divine power and the coldness of Talaris, which filled the basement, were there to prevent Zito's energy from seeping out of the door. Through the cracks of the iron door, where not even a piece of paper could fit, a purplish aura was slowly oozing out.
The one emitting this aura was the Eye of Zito, sealed in the deepest part of the Eternal Warehouse.
'...There is a limit to how long I can hold out alone. Was the Eye of the monster waiting for the moment when the Holy King would fall?'
Talaris had gone out as soon as Phaelito began his invasion. Initially, she tried to resist Phaelito's advance by setting up a counter-barrier, but now she needed to stop Bideluche.
Boom... Crunch!

Suddenly, a heavy explosion and vibration came from outside the castle. This meant the enemies had already pierced the barrier of the Holy King City. Lani clenched her teeth, and a drop of blood trickled down from her lips.
'So soon!? No, it's too fast!'
The vibration was intensifying quickly. Due to the shaking ground, as the crack in the iron door widened, the aura began to fluctuate wildly.
Outside, the situation was much worse than what Lani was experiencing.
"Oh my, look at them. They think they can stop this Bideluche with the remnants of Ayula's protective shield? Such big dreams, really big."
Zzzzap!
Thick purplish beams were being shot from Bideluche's claws. Every time she lightly extended her hand, a large crack formed on the protective shield of the Holy King City.
Bideluche, the Destruction.

In the demonic realm, she symbolized destruction itself. Bideluche fired her beams without paying any heed to her subordinates who were rushing into the cracks of the protective shield. The demon army continued to dig into the protective shield even after seeing their allies die by Bideluche's hand.
There were no civilians on the streets. They had all already taken refuge in underground air raid shelters or inside the Holy King City.
The holy knights formed a barrier around the Holy King City. In their midst, Talaris glared at Bideluche.
There was no leisure on Talaris's face. She had already exhausted much of her strength trying to stop Zito's energy and creating the counter-barrier.
"There, you must be the Holy King. Good. I intended to just recover Lord Zito's physical body, but it seems I can also take the Ever-Ice."
"You're very confident. But listen, demon. Our Holy Kingdom, the Vamel Alliance, has never failed to withstand such moments. You'd better brace yourself as you come in."
"Ahahah, really? You seem to believe in those who are fighting our Phaelito, but they're about to die soon. The game is essentially over. Let's see... there, that would be a good spot."
Videluche looked down at the distant land on Talaris's left, savoring her words. Below was the location of one of the air-raid shelters.

The moment a crimson beam fell towards the shelter, Talaris threw himself forward, shooting out a brilliant white sword qi. As soon as the sword qi bifurcated the beam, Videluche had already appeared right in front of Talaris.
"Keuk!"
Videluche's fist collided with the ice energy.
"Ah, it's a little regrettable? If you hadn't exhausted yourself beforehand, we could have had quite an exciting fight. Now, it's too dull."
"Do demons who feed on the souls that have fallen to hell have the right to talk about taste? Quit your nonsense and wipe the blood running down your cheek."
Videluche paused and touched her right cheek. Blood, cooled by the cold air, was flowing.
"Oh... when the hell? I didn't sense it at all. You were one of the strongest on the surface a generation ago, the reputation wasn't unearned."
As she wiped the blood away, her wound healed immediately. At that moment, the ground near the shelter she had targeted exploded.
"But you didn't protect the humans hiding there. It seems like just under a thousand have been killed by that explosion."
Talaris's eyes twitched. Videluche had already figured out the locations of all the shelters underground.
Talaris quickly made a decision.
"All holy knights, enter the castle and protect the King."
It was impossible to fight while protecting the civilians. Furthermore, the knights were no threat to Videluche. They would only be a hindrance.
"...May the Lord be with you, Archduke."
- Even if you see the people being slaughtered in front of you, you must follow the Archduke's command. None of us can see the battlefield as clearly as him.

The knights entered the castle remembering Lani's command. The situation where they had to ignore the death of their people was unspeakably terrible, but they had no choice. All they could do was pray and protect Lani.
Videluche exploded two more shelters while that brief conversation took place. She leisurely slaughtered civilians, pressuring Talaris.
"Honestly speaking, it's not that fun to kill humans, but it is quite pleasurable to see your face pretending to be unfazed while fighting. So, put on a better performance, it's exciting!"
Every time she blocked Videluche's punch, it felt like his internal injuries would burst. The exhausted Talaris was inevitably at a disadvantage in every way.
Until Murakan arrives.
Whooong....
"Tsk, you've already caught up?"
Suddenly feeling the surroundings darken, Videluche erected a shield. The arrival of darkness, the wave of energy that surged like a tidal wave in the dark, was engulfing Videluche.
[Talaris, are you okay?]
"I'm still okay."
[I was a bit late because I was dealing with the demon's minions.]
"What about Jin and the Sword Emperor?"

Murakan didn't answer. Talaris knew how heavy it was for the Guardian Dragon to come to save others, leaving its contractor in danger. It was the most dreadful decision that the Guardian Dragon could make.
[You've felt it too, haven't you? More demons are coming from all around. I'll defend, so you focus on attacking. Somehow, break through and finish this.]
Talaris nodded her head. Even with Murakan's arrival, it was still her job to take down Bidelluche.
Bidelluche narrowly escaped the darkness of the Dark Advent and was forming the beam again.
And as soon as the violet beam left his palm, Murakan had to roar and release his spiritual energy to the maximum.
Kaaaaaa-!
The Dark Advent expanded rapidly, blocking the onslaught towards the royal castle. The two massive powers, spiritual energy and magic, were colliding and causing a great uproar.
The force striking the Dark Advent right now was not Bidelluche's beam.
'Phaelito, his sword energy has come this far...!'
It was the third Heaven Destroying Slash, the sword energy of Phaelito.
After Murakan started chasing Bidelluche, Phaelito also pushed Jin and Dante out of the Bellium Plain and got closer to the royal castle.
Of course, it wasn't close enough to reach with a sword strike, unless it was a spear star.
A moment later, the shockwave from the two powers subsided. Murakan and Talaris focused their gazes far beyond the crack in the Dark Advent in front of them.
There was a hemisphere similar to the Wall of Death that Sakieli unfolded during the castle siege in Grosh. Jin and Dante were confronting Phaelito within it.
"What are you looking at, kids? No matter how shocking the Heaven Destroying Slash is, it's not right to ignore me like this."
Bidelluche clenched his fist with a very displeased look.
"I'm not that far behind Sword Demon in terms of destructive power. I'm hurt, so let's just finish this quickly."
Soon, the blow from Bidelluche pierced through the layers of spiritual energy barrier and struck the royal castle directly.
All the buildings of the royal castle exposed on the ground turned into particles from that blow. If Lani wasn't in the eternal warehouse on the lowest floor, she would have certainly met death.
Every single knight who tried to enter the royal castle to protect her was completely annihilated.
Murakan and Talaris looked back.
It wasn't because of the shock from the collapse of the royal castle and the annihilation of the knights. Turning your back on a strong opponent like Bidelluche is a suicide mission.
Yet, they turned around because of the earth energy that suddenly began to gush from underneath the collapsed royal castle.
The eyes that Zito had been desperately seeking were finally released from their seal.
